headline: Board of Water Supply

meeting.summary: The board heard that BLNR denied a long-term Mahi Pono water license proposal, and it approved a planning letter and a TIG report.
meeting.recap: The Board of Water Supply meeting began at 1:37 p.m.[[0:00:30]] In a presentation, he said most water in the system comes from state lands.[[0:28:52]] He said ownership of the ditch system matters because the state must price any license through an appraisal.[[0:39:45]] The board unanimously approved a letter to the planning department about water supply in county planning.[[0:46:08]] The next meeting is September 17th at 1:30.[[0:54:33]]
decided: With no objections, the board took the vice chair's presentation out of agenda order.
The board unanimously approved the draft letter to the planning department.
problem statement and discussion questions: The board unanimously approved the problem statement and discussion questions attached to the letter.
meeting.next: A council member's letter about the board's further comments on Bill 1 will be on the next meeting's agenda. Members who plan to draft a response should say so to learn the deadline.

moments.q: "the six members of the board present unanimously rejected the staff's recommendation"
